independent_review: Paired dietary C/P after review found that P was credited independently of consumed organic food.
Removed a fixed external-food share that could report a shortfall despite unused host food; consumed external food precedes host sugar within allocations.
Made turnover/production-efficiency dependence and uncalibrated maintenance explicit.
Reject nonpositive reference host-food budgets before forming fractions.
Reviewed defensive analogues, arithmetic, response geometry, biomass interpretation and claims of ecological adequacy; no remaining material issue identified.

Reviewed nutrient, water and gas-control mechanisms against source access and limits; distinguished experimental food-body limitation from correlations with colony size and herbivory in Heil et al. (2001).
remaining: No calibrated defensive behavior or persistence model.
Unallocated consumer assimilate has no resolved physiological fate.
Extra-load damage and landing dynamics remain unsolved.
Primary source access varies; no claim of complete scholarly reading of every source.
